source.boundary: Employee wage anchors only. Benefits, overhead, contractor margin, task duration and buyer willingness to pay are not identified by these figures.

formulas.buyer_purchase_break_even_human_minutes: t_human_star = max(0, 60 * (price + customer_review_cost + integration_cost / accepted_uses - K_human_nonlabor) / r_human)
formulas.incremental_asset_break_even_accepted_jo: N_star = ceil((full_construction_cost + fixed_upkeep) / (incumbent_full_cost_per_accepted_job - candidate_full_cost_per_accepted_job - incremental_upkeep_per_job)), only when denominator > 0
formulas.nonpositive_saving: If the denominator is zero or negative, no finite repetition repays a positive investment through that saving mechanism.

requirements: Compare the same complete useful accepted deliverable and acceptance standard.
Include failures and correction in cost per equivalent accepted output.
Use actual active human time only when measured; model/agent elapsed time is never a wage bill.
Do not substitute customer savings, token issuance or valuation for enterprise collections.
Simple repayment arithmetic excludes market allocation, competitor response, changing prices and cash timing; use the paired simulator for those conditions.
